newsitem.title: USA: US PSA recommends early debt closing next Wed, Fri.
newsitem.headline: US PSA recommends early debt closing next Wed, Fri.

text.p: The U.S. Public Securities Association (PSA) has recommended early 1400 EST/1900 GMT closings for the U.S. Treasury and related debt markets next Wednesday, November 27 and Friday, November 29, the organization said.

Markets in U.S. government securities, mortgages, over-the-counter investment grade corporate bonds, municipal bonds, and secondary money market trading in bankers acceptances, commercial paper and Yankee and Euro certificates of deposit will all be closed on Thursday, November 28 for the Thanksgiving Day holiday.
PSA said, as always, the early closes will not affect the closing time for settlements.
